decisions.facts: 2.6-5.4x the creator revenue of 0.03 bulk-split; higher return at 20 ETH; at 1.96 ETH 0.03 bulk-split's median is slightly higher under all-bid and observed behaviour with a milder tail
backing 0.06489617486338 ETH; keep advantage +0.0003 ETH at any assumption; keeper ceiling no longer affects listing
settlement from FWA's record; pricing gated and bounded at 32 allocation entries; while kicks are possible (exemption lifted) every open listing is checked, at most 32
decisions.residual: if FWA lifts the exemption, a kick refund is force-sent with no receipt, and FWA restores the exemption before sync, pricing counts the refund beside the position: NAV high by 0.0649 ETH per such kick until the permissionless sync
decisions.above_32_listings: the kick check is skipped above 32 open listings, so pricing never waits on FWA's exemption; an unrecorded kick refund there (receive above FWA's 100,000 gas stipend) would price one backing high until sync
